name: vimeo
description: Vimeo MCP server and CLI for Claude Code, Codex and AI agents. 43 tools for transcripts, bulk folder filing, showcases, chapters, captions, tags, privacy and embed presets.
long_description:
Connects Claude to your Vimeo library: transcripts, bulk folder filing, showcases, chapters, captions, tags, privacy and embed presets.

It needs a personal access token from your app at developer.vimeo.com/apps, with the scopes for what you want to change. Deleting videos or folders refuses to run without an explicit confirmation, and Read only removes every write.

token.title: Vimeo personal access token
token.description: From your app's Authentication section at developer.vimeo.com/apps.

read_only.title: Read only
read_only.description: Hide every tool that can change or delete a video, folder or showcase.
